intuition.title: Post-workup ligand addition is a stability treatment
intuition.text: Washed colloids can leave a film after several days. About 0.1 mg HDA per 25 mg nanocrystals dissolves it promptly, and the colloid then remains stable in air for months. This qualitative storage context is distinct from growth and does not create another measured particle-size outcome.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
